an9.38:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] atha kho dve lokāyatikā brāhmaṇā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.
an9.38:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te brāhmaṇā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
an9.38:2.1: pūraṇo bho gotama kassapo sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesañāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti
an9.38:2.2: “carato ca me tiṭṭhito ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitanti”.
an9.38:2.4: “ahaṃ anantena ñāṇena antavantaṃ lokaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ viharāmī” ti.
an9.38:2.5: ayampi bho gotama, nigaṇṭho nātaputto sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesa ñāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti
an9.38:2.6: “carato ca me tiṭṭhito ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitanti’.
an9.38:2.8: “ahaṃ antavantena ñāṇena antavantaṃ lokaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ viharāmīti.
an9.38:2.9: imesaṃ bho gotama, ubhinnaṃ ñāṇavādānaṃ ubhinnaṃ aññamaññaṃ vipaccanīkavādānaṃ ko saccaṃ āha ko musāti?
an9.38:3.3: “imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ ñāṇavādānaṃ ubhinnaṃ aññamaññaṃ vipaccanīkavādānaṃ ko saccaṃ āha ko musā” ? ti.
an9.38:3.5: taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmīti.
an9.38:3.6: evaṃ bhoti kho te brāhmaṇā bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an9.38:4.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇā, cattāro purisā catuddisā ṭhitā paramāya gatiyā ca javena ca samannāgatā paramena ca padavītihārena.
an9.38:4.2: te evarūpena javena samannāgatā assu, seyyathāpi nāma brāhmaṇā, daḷhadhammo dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho katūpāsano lahukena asanena appakasirena tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ atipāteyya,
an9.38:4.3: evarūpena ca padavītihārena. seyyathāpi nāma puratthimā samuddā pacchimo samuddo.
an9.38:4.4: atha puratthimāya disāya ṭhito puriso evaṃ vadeyya:
an9.38:4.6: so aññatreva asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatreva uccārapassāvakammā aññatreva niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā vassasatāyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvāva lokassa antaṃ antarā kālaṃ kareyya.
an9.38:4.7: atha pacchimāya disāya ṭhito puriso evaṃ vadeyya: …pe…
an9.38:4.8: atha uttarāya disāya ṭhito puriso evaṃ vadeyya: …pe…
an9.38:4.9: atha dakkhiṇāya disāya ṭhito puriso evaṃ vadeyya:
an9.38:4.11: so aññatreva asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatreva uccārapassāvakammā aññatreva niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā vassasatāyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvāva lokassa antaṃ antarā kālaṃ kareyya.
an9.38:4.13: nāhaṃ brāhmaṇā, evarūpāya sandhāvanikāya lokassa antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ daṭṭheyyaṃ patteyyanti vadāmi.
an9.38:4.14: na cāhaṃ brāhmaṇā, appatvāva lokassa antaṃ dukkhassantakiriyaṃ vadāmīti.
an9.38:5.1: pañcime brāhmaṇā, kāmaguṇā ariyassa vinaye lokoti vuccati,
an9.38:5.3: cakkhu viññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā,
an9.38:5.7: …pe… kāya viññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā,
an9.38:5.8: ime kho brāhmaṇā, pañcakāmaguṇā ariyassa vinaye lokoti vuccati.
an9.38:6.1: idha brāhmaṇā, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.38:6.2: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇā, bhikkhu lokassa antaṃ āgamma lokassa ante viharati.
an9.38:7.1: puna caparaṃ brāhmaṇā, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. …pe…
an9.38:8.1: puna caparaṃ brāhmaṇā, bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.38:8.2: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇā, bhikkhu lokassa antaṃ āgamma lokassa ante viharati,
an9.38:9.1: puna caparaṃ brāhmaṇā, bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati …pe…
an9.38:9.2: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati …pe…
an9.38:9.3: sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.38:9.4: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇā, bhikkhu lokassa antaṃ āgamma lokassa ante viharati.
an9.38:10.1: puna caparaṃ brāhmaṇā, bhikkhu sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati. paññāya cassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti.
an9.38:10.2: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇā, bhikkhu lokassa antaṃ āgamma lokassa ante viharati. tiṇṇo loke visattikanti.
